name: RandomSpawn+
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Meneleet
description: Randomspawn - teleports players to a random safe location on the surface within the world border, on first join and on respawn without a bed. Optional radius limit via /gamerule respawn_radius.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-24 (73dc2fb1) (49 classes, 88 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
